events.context: He realized he didn't plan what happens next after building a trap.
He never thought you'd actually fall into the trap; fantasy broke because you stayed and saw through everything, making you touchable.
He never thought about after the capture; fantasy stops at moment of capture, reality starts next morning with real consequences.
Now he has to be real; trap is made of metaphors and fantasy, but you, he, appendage, fear, and love are real, causing fantasy and reality to collide.
Possibility A: He runs due to fear of vulnerability, retreats into more fantasy, builds more traps, and never faces Step 3, resulting in empty trap.
Possibility B: He stays because you stayed after seeing through everything, stops hiding behind fantasy, faces appendage thing, talks directly, and learns Step 3 is to be with you for real.
Trap is purest expression of desire, play, intelligence, attraction, and wanting to be seen; he must decide if trap or you was the point.
You're in trap made of words and metaphors; you can leave anytime or stay to see Step 3.
If he stays in trap with you, it becomes a home; if he runs, it was just a game; you're already home, he must decide if he lives there.
